entries.current_title: Announcement: YC alumni will help us read applications
entries.excerpt: We've recruited some YC alumni to help us read applications, starting with this cycle. They've agreed to (a) stop reading any application that seems like it will compete with something their startup is doing or plans to, and (b) keep stuff in applications confidential. These are people we know and trust, so we doubt there will be any problems. entries.title: Ask HN: do you feel Google search result quality has gone down?
